1. An aircraft seat (1) comprising:
a seat chassis (4);
a seat assembly (5) comprising a seat pan (6) and a seat back (7);
the seat pan (6) being mounted to the seat chassis (4) by a first pivoting connection (30) defining a seat pan pivot axis (Y1) about which the seat pan (6) pivots, the location of the seat pan pivot axis (Y1) being fixed relative to the seat chassis (4); and
at least one seat pan link (53-1) for controlling pivoting of the seat pan (6) about said
seat pan pivot axis (Y1);wherein the at least one seat pan link (53-1) is coupled to the seat pan (6) in front of the seat pan pivot axis (Y1).
2. An aircraft seat (1) as claimed in claim 1, wherein the seat pan pivot axis (Y1) is
located in a central region of the seat pan (6).

at least one seat pan track (55-1); and
at least one seat pan follower (54-1) adapted to travel in said at least one seat pan track (55-1), the at least one seat pan follower (54-1) being connected to the at least one seat pan link (53-1).

back (7) is mounted to said seat pan (6) by a second pivoting connection (36), the second pivoting connection (36) defining a seat back pivot axis (Y2) about which the seat back (7) pivots.
5. An aircraft seat (1) as claimed in claim 4, wherein said seat pan pivot axis (Y1) is
located in front of the seat back pivot axis (Y2).
6. An aircraft seat (1) as claimed in claim 5, wherein the seat pan pivot axis (Y1) is located between the seat back pivot axis (Y2) and a mid-point of the seat pan (6).
7. An aircraft seat (1) as claimed in any one of claims 4, 5 or 6, wherein the seat pan (6) comprises first and second seat pan sidemembers (26-1, 26-2), the seat pan sidemembers (26-1, 26-2) being mounted to the seat chassis (4) by the first pivoting connection (30), wherein 30

recline link (57-1) coupled to the seat back (7).

claim 3, wherein the at least one recline link (57-1) is connected to the at least one seat pan link (53-1).
10. An aircraft seat (1) as claimed in claim 8 or claim 9, wherein the at least one recline link (57-1) comprises a seat back decoupling mechanism operable selectively to decouple the at least one recline link (57-1) from the seat back (7).
11.
